data.association_policy: Two-sided monotonic rank association on matched participants,using conventional asymptotic Spearman p with ties; no equal physical scaling or linear relationship is assumed.

source_provenance.dataset: Authentic Linnerud observations,20 middle-aged men in a fitness club
source_provenance.units: Original source numeric units; the documentation does not specify a complete physical-unit table,so no unit conversion or clinical threshold is inferred.
source_provenance.licensing_note: Redistributed by scikit-learn; original dataset page gives citation but no separate dataset-specific license statement.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
